scientific_integrity.claim: An exact colored-incidence enumeration and a sharp fixed-q, fixed-t theta-asymptotic probability for pairwise commuting idempotent tuples in upper triangular algebras.
limitations: The sharp asymptotic is for fixed finite-field order q and fixed tuple size t as n increases; it does not cover varying q or t.
The theta leading coefficients are indexed by n modulo 2^t; minimal period is not asserted.
The incidence-algebra coloring identity is exact for any finite poset, but a chain-like asymptotic is not asserted for arbitrary posets.
Full text of two relevant triangular-idempotent enumeration articles was unavailable, leaving a publication-priority risk.
Previously established simultaneous conjugacy of commuting incidence-algebra idempotents is not claimed as new.
Independent mathematical audit and exhaustive literature-priority review have not been performed.
scientific_integrity.proven_limits: All n≥0 for exact formulas; positive integer n→∞ and q prime power, t≥2 fixed for asymptotics.
scientific_integrity.reproducibility: verify.py, standard-library Python; direct exhaustive finite-field and incidence-poset checks.

title: Sharp theta laws for commuting idempotent tuples in finite triangular algebras
